description: This file defines the 'OAuthAuthorizationCode' entity class used within the OrangeHRM system for managing OAuth2 authorization codes. It includes ORM mapping annotations to specify database table and columns, along with getter and setter methods for each property, managing OAuth authorization code data such as code, client ID, user ID, redirect URI, expiry, and revocation status.

classes.name: OAuthAuthorizationCode
classes.description: Entity class representing OAuth2 authorization code with properties for code, client ID, user ID, redirect URI, expiry time, and revocation status, mapped to database table 'ohrm_oauth2_authorization_code'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the authorization code record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the authorization code record.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Gets the client ID associated with the authorization code.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the user ID associated with the authorization code.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI registered for the authorization code.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry DateTimeImmutable object for the authorization code, ensuring UTC timezone.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry DateTimeImmutable object for the authorization code.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether the authorization code has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Sets the revoked status of the authorization code.
